doc: Fill in, save as edits.json, then: python3 course_data/mapper/write_layers.py tournament_club_iowa. See course_data/mapper/BRIEF.md for ops, shapes and rules. long_grass: a verdict per side on every hole, 'native: <edits>' or 'none: <what both years show>' (S2 silence is not a verdict). s2_suggested: Sentinel-2 native candidates (hint, not a layer): per hole and side set every candidate's decision to accept (its shape becomes add native with your confidence + evidence; the 10-yd keep-out applies), reject (evidence = why) or replace (you drew your own native edit in `edits`, e.g. the traced edge); undecided ones are listed in review.md.

1.note: prairie left of the left cart path from 255 and all around the creek at 320-365; R2 beyond the right cart path

long_grass.L: native: edit 0 (left cart path is the mowing line from ~255 to the creek) and edit 1 past the creek
long_grass.R: native: edit 1 (creek band 325-365 beyond the right cart path) and S2-1-R2 beyond the right cart path at 160-265

edits.evidence: tufted coarse prairie left of the cart path in 2023, darker coarse in 2021; the cart path is a fixed mowing line (smooth striped turf inside it), 20-35 yds off the package fairway
tall tufted grass with seed heads from the right cart path to the tree line around the creek, 2023; coarse in 2021; the cart path is the mowing line

L.evidence: pond / bare ground / trees and another hole's mown turf at 120-185 left; no mowing line with tall grass behind it
cart-path spur among trees at 185-220; shade and rough under crowns
prairie is real but the S2 shape crosses the cart path onto the mown rough; traced as edit 0 on the cart path
native around the creek, traced in edits 0/1 at the water line and tree edge

R.evidence: trees and the cart-path junction near the pond at 120-168; no open tall grass
coarse streaky grass beyond the right cart path at 160-265 in 2023, coarse in 2021; the cart path is the mowing line, 25+ yds off the fairway
native beyond the right cart path around the creek, traced as edit 1 following the cart path

edits.evidence: mottled coarse grass with scattered shrubs (lidar yellow speckle) beyond the cart path, 2023; similar mottled in 2021; mown strip between path and fairway
